update "runs" set "state" = ?, "claimed_by" = ?, "claim_gen" = "claim_gen" + ?, "lease_ms" = ?, "claim_expires_at_ms" = COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
) + ?, "heartbeat_at_ms" = COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
), "wake_step" = coalesce("wake_step", (SELECT MIN(w.step_name)
           FROM waits w
           WHERE w.run_id = runs.run_id
      AND w.queue = runs.queue
      AND w.task_id = runs.task_id
      AND w.event_name = runs.wake_event
      AND w.status = 'waiting'
      AND w.timeout_at_ms IS NOT DISTINCT FROM runs.available_at_ms
      AND (runs.available_at_ms IS NULL
        OR ((runs.available_at_ms) IS NOT NULL AND runs.available_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000))
      AND (w.timeout_at_ms IS NULL
        OR ((w.timeout_at_ms) IS NOT NULL AND w.timeout_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000))
           GROUP BY w.run_id
            HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)), "fence_stamp" = ?, "fence_at_ms" = COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
) where "run_id" in (
         WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
           SELECT r.run_id
           FROM runs r JOIN tasks t ON t.task_id = r.task_id AND t.queue = r.queue
           WHERE r.queue = ? AND r.state IN ('pending','sleeping')
             AND (((r.available_at_ms) IS NOT NULL AND r.available_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)
    AND r.available_at_ms <= COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
))
             AND t.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping') AND (t.cancel_at_ms IS NULL
    OR (((t.cancel_at_ms) IS NOT NULL AND t.cancel_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)
      AND t.cancel_at_ms > COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)))
               AND (
    CASE
      WHEN NOT pg_input_is_valid(t.retry_strategy, 'jsonb') THEN 0
      WHEN NOT (t.retry_strategy IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) THEN 0
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'kind') <> 'string' THEN 0
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'none' THEN 1
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'fixed' THEN CASE WHEN (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'baseSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'exponential' THEN CASE
        WHEN (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'baseSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END)
          AND (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'factor') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      ELSE ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'factor')::numeric) BETWEEN 0 AND 1.7976931348623157e308
    END)
          AND (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'maxSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0
    END = 1
  )
               AND (
    CASE
      WHEN t.headers IS NULL THEN 1
      WHEN NOT pg_input_is_valid(t.headers, 'jsonb') THEN 0
      WHEN NOT (t.headers IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) THEN 0
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(t.headers::jsonb) h
        WHERE jsonb_typeof(h.value) <> 'string'
      ) THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END = 1
  )
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs sibling
               WHERE sibling.task_id = r.task_id
                 AND sibling.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
                 AND sibling.run_id <> r.run_id)
               AND (r.wake_step IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM waits w
                          WHERE w.run_id = r.run_id
      AND w.queue = r.queue
      AND w.task_id = r.task_id
      AND w.event_name = r.wake_event
      AND w.status = 'waiting'
      AND w.timeout_at_ms IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.available_at_ms
      AND (r.available_at_ms IS NULL
        OR ((r.available_at_ms) IS NOT NULL AND r.available_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000))
      AND (w.timeout_at_ms IS NULL
        OR ((w.timeout_at_ms) IS NOT NULL AND w.timeout_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000))
                          GROUP BY w.run_id
                              HAVING COUNT(*) > 1))
               AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM waits w
      WHERE w.run_id = r.run_id AND w.status = 'waiting'
        AND w.timeout_at_ms IS NOT NULL
        AND NOT ((w.timeout_at_ms) IS NOT NULL AND w.timeout_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)
    )
               AND ((r.claim_gen) IS NOT NULL AND r.claim_gen BETWEEN 0 AND 999999)
               AND ((r.activated_gen) IS NOT NULL AND r.activated_gen BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
               AND r.activated_gen <= r.claim_gen
               AND ((r.relaunch_count) IS NOT NULL AND r.relaunch_count BETWEEN 0 AND 5)
               AND (((r.attempt) IS NOT NULL AND r.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000020)
    AND ((t.attempts) IS NOT NULL AND t.attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
    AND ((t.max_attempts) IS NOT NULL AND t.max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
    AND ((t.infra_retries) IS NOT NULL AND t.infra_retries BETWEEN 0 AND 20)
    AND t.attempts < t.max_attempts
    AND r.attempt = t.attempts + t.infra_retries + 1)
               AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM runs higher
    WHERE higher.task_id = r.task_id
      AND (NOT ((higher.attempt) IS NOT NULL AND higher.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000020)
        OR higher.attempt > r.attempt)
  )
           ORDER BY r.available_at_ms, r.run_id
           LIMIT ?
           FOR UPDATE OF r SKIP LOCKED
         )
         SELECT run_id FROM candidates
       ) and not exists (select "held"."run_id" from "runs" as "held" where "held"."queue" = ? and "held"."state" = ? and "held"."claimed_by" = ?) and ((COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)) IS NOT NULL
    AND (COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)) BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000
    AND (COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)) <= 253402300799000 - (CAST((?) AS BIGINT)))

UPDATE tasks SET state = 'running',
         last_attempt_run = (SELECT MIN(f.run_id)
           FROM runs f
           WHERE f.task_id = tasks.task_id AND f.fence_stamp = ?
           GROUP BY f.task_id
            HAVING COUNT(*) = 1),
         fence_stamp = ?,
         fence_at_ms = (SELECT MIN(f.fence_at_ms) FROM runs f
                        WHERE (f.queue = ? AND f.state = 'running') AND f.queue = tasks.queue AND f.fence_stamp = ?)
       WHERE (task_id IN (SELECT f.task_id FROM runs f
                       WHERE (f.queue = ? AND f.state = 'running') AND f.queue = tasks.queue AND f.fence_stamp = ?)
         AND (state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')))

DELETE FROM waits
       WHERE (run_id IN (SELECT f.run_id FROM runs f
                       WHERE (f.queue = ? AND f.state = 'running') AND f.fence_stamp = ?)
         AND (status = 'waiting'
            AND ((timeout_at_ms) IS NOT NULL AND timeout_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)
            AND timeout_at_ms <= (SELECT f.fence_at_ms FROM runs f WHERE f.run_id = waits.run_id AND f.fence_stamp = ?)))

SELECT r.run_id, r.task_id, r.attempt, r.claim_gen, r.claim_expires_at_ms, r.lease_ms,
       r.wake_event, r.event_payload, r.wake_step,
       t.task_name, t.params, t.retry_strategy, t.max_attempts, t.headers, t.infra_retries
       FROM runs r JOIN tasks t ON t.task_id = r.task_id AND t.queue = r.queue
       WHERE r.queue = ? AND r.claimed_by = ? AND r.state = 'running'
         AND t.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
         AND (
    CASE
      WHEN NOT pg_input_is_valid(t.retry_strategy, 'jsonb') THEN 0
      WHEN NOT (t.retry_strategy IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) THEN 0
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'kind') <> 'string' THEN 0
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'none' THEN 1
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'fixed' THEN CASE WHEN (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'baseSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'exponential' THEN CASE
        WHEN (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'baseSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END)
          AND (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'factor') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      ELSE ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'factor')::numeric) BETWEEN 0 AND 1.7976931348623157e308
    END)
          AND (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'maxSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0
    END = 1
  )
         AND (
    CASE
      WHEN t.headers IS NULL THEN 1
      WHEN NOT pg_input_is_valid(t.headers, 'jsonb') THEN 0
      WHEN NOT (t.headers IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) THEN 0
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(t.headers::jsonb) h
        WHERE jsonb_typeof(h.value) <> 'string'
      ) THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END = 1
  )
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs sibling
               WHERE sibling.task_id = r.task_id
                 AND sibling.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
                 AND sibling.run_id <> r.run_id)
         AND ((r.claim_gen) IS NOT NULL AND r.claim_gen BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
         AND ((r.activated_gen) IS NOT NULL AND r.activated_gen BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
         AND r.activated_gen <= r.claim_gen
         AND ((r.relaunch_count) IS NOT NULL AND r.relaunch_count BETWEEN 0 AND 5)
         AND ((r.lease_ms) IS NOT NULL AND r.lease_ms BETWEEN 1 AND 3155760000000)
         AND ((r.claim_expires_at_ms) IS NOT NULL AND r.claim_expires_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)
         AND (((r.attempt) IS NOT NULL AND r.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000020)
    AND ((t.attempts) IS NOT NULL AND t.attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
    AND ((t.max_attempts) IS NOT NULL AND t.max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
    AND ((t.infra_retries) IS NOT NULL AND t.infra_retries BETWEEN 0 AND 20)
    AND t.attempts < t.max_attempts
    AND r.attempt = t.attempts + t.infra_retries + 1)
         AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM runs higher
    WHERE higher.task_id = r.task_id
      AND (NOT ((higher.attempt) IS NOT NULL AND higher.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000020)
        OR higher.attempt > r.attempt)
  )
       ORDER BY r.run_id

update "runs" set "activated_gen" = ?, "started_at_ms" = coalesce("started_at_ms", COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)), "claim_expires_at_ms" = COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
) + lease_ms, "heartbeat_at_ms" = COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
), "fence_stamp" = ?, "fence_at_ms" = COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
) where "run_id" = ? and "queue" = ? and "claimed_by" = ? and "state" = ? and "claim_gen" = ? and "activated_gen" < ? and (((runs.claim_gen) IS NOT NULL AND runs.claim_gen BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
    AND ((runs.activated_gen) IS NOT NULL AND runs.activated_gen BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
    AND ((runs.lease_ms) IS NOT NULL AND runs.lease_ms BETWEEN 1 AND 3155760000000)
    AND ((runs.relaunch_count) IS NOT NULL AND runs.relaunch_count BETWEEN 0 AND 5)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs sibling
               WHERE sibling.task_id = runs.task_id
                 AND sibling.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
                 AND sibling.run_id <> runs.run_id)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM tasks t
      WHERE t.task_id = runs.task_id AND t.queue = runs.queue AND t.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping') AND (t.cancel_at_ms IS NULL
    OR (((t.cancel_at_ms) IS NOT NULL AND t.cancel_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)
      AND t.cancel_at_ms > COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)))
        AND (
    CASE
      WHEN NOT pg_input_is_valid(t.retry_strategy, 'jsonb') THEN 0
      WHEN NOT (t.retry_strategy IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) THEN 0
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'kind') <> 'string' THEN 0
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'none' THEN 1
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'fixed' THEN CASE WHEN (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'baseSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'exponential' THEN CASE
        WHEN (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'baseSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END)
          AND (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'factor') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      ELSE ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'factor')::numeric) BETWEEN 0 AND 1.7976931348623157e308
    END)
          AND (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'maxSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0
    END = 1
  )
        AND (
    CASE
      WHEN t.headers IS NULL THEN 1
      WHEN NOT pg_input_is_valid(t.headers, 'jsonb') THEN 0
      WHEN NOT (t.headers IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) THEN 0
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(t.headers::jsonb) h
        WHERE jsonb_typeof(h.value) <> 'string'
      ) THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END = 1
  )
        AND (((runs.attempt) IS NOT NULL AND runs.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000020)
    AND ((t.attempts) IS NOT NULL AND t.attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
    AND ((t.max_attempts) IS NOT NULL AND t.max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
    AND ((t.infra_retries) IS NOT NULL AND t.infra_retries BETWEEN 0 AND 20)
    AND t.attempts < t.max_attempts
    AND runs.attempt = t.attempts + t.infra_retries + 1)
        AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM runs higher
    WHERE higher.task_id = runs.task_id
      AND (NOT ((higher.attempt) IS NOT NULL AND higher.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000020)
        OR higher.attempt > runs.attempt)
  )
        AND (CASE
    WHEN t.cancellation IS NULL THEN 1
    WHEN NOT pg_input_is_valid(t.cancellation, 'jsonb') THEN 0
    WHEN NOT (t.cancellation IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) THEN 0
    WHEN (t.cancellation::jsonb -> 'maxDurationSeconds') IS NULL THEN 1
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.cancellation::jsonb -> 'maxDurationSeconds') <> 'number' THEN 0
    WHEN (((t.cancellation::jsonb ->> 'maxDurationSeconds')::numeric)) < 0 OR (((t.cancellation::jsonb ->> 'maxDurationSeconds')::numeric)) > 3155760000000 THEN 0
    WHEN (CAST(ROUND(
    ((t.cancellation::jsonb ->> 'maxDurationSeconds')::numeric) * 1000
  ) AS BIGINT)) > 3155760000000 THEN 0
    WHEN NOT ((COALESCE(t.first_started_at_ms, COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
))) IS NOT NULL
    AND (COALESCE(t.first_started_at_ms, COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
))) BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000
    AND (COALESCE(t.first_started_at_ms, COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
))) <= 253402300799000 - (CAST((CAST(ROUND(
    ((t.cancellation::jsonb ->> 'maxDurationSeconds')::numeric) * 1000
  ) AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT))) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END = 1)
    )) and ((COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)) IS NOT NULL
    AND (COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)) BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000
    AND (COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)) <= 253402300799000 - (CAST((runs.lease_ms) AS BIGINT)))

UPDATE tasks SET first_started_at_ms = COALESCE(first_started_at_ms, (SELECT f.fence_at_ms FROM runs f WHERE f.run_id = ? AND f.fence_stamp = ?)),
         cancel_at_ms = CASE
          WHEN (cancellation::jsonb -> 'maxDurationSeconds') IS NOT NULL THEN
            COALESCE(first_started_at_ms, (SELECT f.fence_at_ms FROM runs f WHERE f.run_id = ? AND f.fence_stamp = ?)) + CAST(ROUND(
    ((tasks.cancellation::jsonb ->> 'maxDurationSeconds')::numeric) * 1000
  ) AS BIGINT)
          ELSE NULL
        END,
         fence_stamp = ?,
         fence_at_ms = (SELECT MIN(f.fence_at_ms) FROM runs f
                        WHERE (f.run_id = ?) AND f.queue = tasks.queue AND f.fence_stamp = ?)
       WHERE (task_id IN (SELECT f.task_id FROM runs f
                       WHERE (f.run_id = ?) AND f.queue = tasks.queue AND f.fence_stamp = ?)
         AND (state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')))

SELECT r.run_id, r.task_id, r.attempt, r.claim_gen, r.claim_expires_at_ms, r.lease_ms,
       r.wake_event, r.event_payload, r.wake_step,
       t.task_name, t.params, t.retry_strategy, t.max_attempts, t.headers, t.infra_retries
       FROM runs r JOIN tasks t ON t.task_id = r.task_id AND t.queue = r.queue
       WHERE r.run_id = ? AND r.fence_stamp = ? AND r.state = 'running'

completed.sql:
update "runs" set "state" = ?, "completed_at_ms" = COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
), "result" = ?, "wake_event" = ?, "event_payload" = ?, "wake_step" = ?, "claimed_by" = ?, "claim_expires_at_ms" = ?, "fence_stamp" = ?, "fence_at_ms" = COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
) where "run_id" = ? and "queue" = ? and "claimed_by" = ? and "state" = ? and EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM tasks t
  WHERE t.task_id = runs.task_id AND t.queue = runs.queue
    AND (t.state NOT IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
      OR (t.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs sibling
               WHERE sibling.task_id = runs.task_id
                 AND sibling.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
                 AND sibling.run_id <> runs.run_id)))
)

UPDATE tasks SET state = 'completed',
         completed_payload = ?,
         cancel_at_ms = NULL,
         fence_stamp = ?,
         fence_at_ms = (SELECT MIN(f.fence_at_ms) FROM runs f
                        WHERE (f.run_id = ?) AND f.queue = tasks.queue AND f.fence_stamp = ?)
       WHERE (task_id IN (SELECT f.task_id FROM runs f
                       WHERE (f.run_id = ?) AND f.queue = tasks.queue AND f.fence_stamp = ?)
         AND (state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')))

DELETE FROM waits
       WHERE (run_id IN (SELECT f.run_id FROM runs f
                       WHERE (f.run_id = ?) AND f.fence_stamp = ?))

deferred.sql:
update "runs" set "state" = case when (CASE WHEN ? = 1 THEN COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
) + ? ELSE ? END) <= COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
) then ? else ? end, "available_at_ms" = (CASE WHEN ? = 1 THEN COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
) + ? ELSE ? END), "claimed_by" = ?, "claim_expires_at_ms" = ?, "heartbeat_at_ms" = ?, "fence_stamp" = ?, "fence_at_ms" = COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
) where "run_id" = ? and "queue" = ? and "claimed_by" = ? and "state" = ? and "claim_gen" = ? and "activated_gen" < ? and (((runs.claim_gen) IS NOT NULL AND runs.claim_gen BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
    AND ((runs.activated_gen) IS NOT NULL AND runs.activated_gen BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
    AND ((runs.lease_ms) IS NOT NULL AND runs.lease_ms BETWEEN 1 AND 3155760000000)
    AND ((runs.relaunch_count) IS NOT NULL AND runs.relaunch_count BETWEEN 0 AND 5)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs sibling
               WHERE sibling.task_id = runs.task_id
                 AND sibling.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')
                 AND sibling.run_id <> runs.run_id)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM tasks t
      WHERE t.task_id = runs.task_id AND t.queue = runs.queue AND t.state IN ('pending','running','sleeping') AND (t.cancel_at_ms IS NULL
    OR (((t.cancel_at_ms) IS NOT NULL AND t.cancel_at_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000)
      AND t.cancel_at_ms > COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)))
        AND (
    CASE
      WHEN NOT pg_input_is_valid(t.retry_strategy, 'jsonb') THEN 0
      WHEN NOT (t.retry_strategy IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) THEN 0
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'kind') <> 'string' THEN 0
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'none' THEN 1
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'fixed' THEN CASE WHEN (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'baseSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'kind')) = 'exponential' THEN CASE
        WHEN (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'baseSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'baseSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END)
          AND (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'factor') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      ELSE ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'factor')::numeric) BETWEEN 0 AND 1.7976931348623157e308
    END)
          AND (CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.retry_strategy::jsonb -> 'maxSeconds') <> 'number' THEN FALSE
      WHEN ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) < 0 OR ((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) > 3155760000000 THEN FALSE
      ELSE ROUND(((t.retry_strategy::jsonb ->> 'maxSeconds')::numeric) * 1000) BETWEEN 0 AND 3155760000000
    END)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0
    END = 1
  )
        AND (
    CASE
      WHEN t.headers IS NULL THEN 1
      WHEN NOT pg_input_is_valid(t.headers, 'jsonb') THEN 0
      WHEN NOT (t.headers IS JSON OBJECT WITH UNIQUE KEYS) THEN 0
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(t.headers::jsonb) h
        WHERE jsonb_typeof(h.value) <> 'string'
      ) THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END = 1
  )
        AND (((runs.attempt) IS NOT NULL AND runs.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000020)
    AND ((t.attempts) IS NOT NULL AND t.attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
    AND ((t.max_attempts) IS NOT NULL AND t.max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
    AND ((t.infra_retries) IS NOT NULL AND t.infra_retries BETWEEN 0 AND 20)
    AND t.attempts < t.max_attempts
    AND runs.attempt = t.attempts + t.infra_retries + 1)
        AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM runs higher
    WHERE higher.task_id = runs.task_id
      AND (NOT ((higher.attempt) IS NOT NULL AND higher.attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 1000020)
        OR higher.attempt > runs.attempt)
  )
    )) and (CASE WHEN ? = 1 THEN ((COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)) IS NOT NULL
    AND (COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)) BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799000
    AND (COALESCE(
  (SELECT CAST(value AS BIGINT) FROM meta WHERE key = 'fake_now_ms'),
  CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM statement_timestamp()) * 1000) AS BIGINT)
)) <= 253402300799000 - (CAST((?) AS BIGINT))) ELSE TRUE END)

UPDATE tasks SET state = (SELECT f.state FROM runs f
               WHERE f.run_id = ? AND f.fence_stamp = ?),
         fence_stamp = ?,
         fence_at_ms = (SELECT MIN(f.fence_at_ms) FROM runs f
                        WHERE (f.run_id = ?) AND f.queue = tasks.queue AND f.fence_stamp = ?)
       WHERE (task_id IN (SELECT f.task_id FROM runs f
                       WHERE (f.run_id = ?) AND f.queue = tasks.queue AND f.fence_stamp = ?)
         AND (state IN ('pending','running','sleeping')))

DELETE FROM waits
       WHERE (run_id IN (SELECT f.run_id FROM runs f
                       WHERE (f.run_id = ?) AND f.fence_stamp = ?))
